# Copilot instructions

Audiences: peers and collaborators, recruiters and hiring managers; secondary: Indonesian students (mentoring).

## RULES (apply to all phases)

- Never invent facts, numbers, titles, dates, abstracts, citations or testimonials. Use only text that already exists in this repo. If something is missing, add a visible TODO comment and list it in your summary.
- Do not change numeric claims in _data/*/cv.yml or assets/json/resume_*.json. Only report contradictions.
- Do not edit _bibliography/papers.bib except where a phase says so.
- Every user-facing change must exist in en-us and id-id. If you cannot translate with confidence, copy the English text and add a TODO-ID comment.
- No em dashes in anything you write. Plain, specific wording. Avoid stock phrases such as passionate, cutting-edge, journey, delve, leverage.
- Minimal, reviewable changes, one concern per commit. Do not reformat unrelated files.
- No new trackers, cookies or third-party scripts. The site owner is in Denmark (GDPR).
- Do not add new details about internal employer (GN/Jabra) tools beyond what is already on the site.
- Before finishing each phase: the site builds locally without warnings, Prettier passes, and lychee shows no new broken links.
